purpose: Request a TDD-preserving phased authorization: implement only the frozen S6-I1 deterministic core, while preparing specifications and expected-red tests for S6-I2 through S6-I4 without implementing those later slices or executing an optimizer.

supersedes.reason: v0.1 predated the frozen additive fallback contracts and covered only four tests.

bound_frozen_tdd_baseline.amendment_rule: No frozen v0.1 or v0.2 byte may be changed. Any contract change requires a new version and a separately hash-bound author freeze before confirmatory use.

carried_provenance_warning.required_disposition: Preserve the frozen bytes, disclose the warning in every implementation receipt and use direct process exit codes for new evidence.

I1.meaning: Create only the allowlisted deterministic graph, donor, RNG and FFE-accounting source needed to satisfy the six frozen tests.

R234.meaning: For parent SHADE, online CVGR integration and the dry-run experiment system, create versioned specifications, fixtures and expected-red tests only; do not create their production implementations.

T1.meaning: Run the six frozen deterministic tests and non-optimizer static/import checks while implementing S6-I1.

T234.meaning: Run only the new S6-I2/I3/I4 contract tests to confirm their expected missing-implementation red state, then stop for a new freeze.

G.meaning: Initialize local Git only for provenance, preserving all existing files; do not configure a remote, push, publish, rewrite history or delete user work.

E.meaning: Do not construct or execute an optimizer run, pilot, benchmark, M/C1/F/C2, Stage B or TCAC workflow.

F.meaning: No objective or constraint evaluator may be called and formal FFE must remain zero.

phase_A_S6_I1_production.required_exit_gate: All six frozen tests pass without editing a frozen byte; source, environment, command and direct process-exit evidence are hash-bound; optimizer runs and formal FFE remain zero.

phase_B_S6_I2_I4_red_preparation.required_exit_gate: New tests fail only for the deliberately absent S6-I2/I3/I4 production APIs; candidate is hash-verified; stop for author freeze before implementing those APIs.

hard_stop_conditions: Any frozen plan, fixture, test, method, preregistration, seed, endpoint, budget or kill-criterion byte changes.
Any need to install a dependency, access the network, alter the Python environment or write outside the allowlist without a new authorization.
Any objective or constraint evaluator call, optimizer generation loop, benchmark adapter evaluation or formal FFE.
Any attempt to implement S6-I2, S6-I3 or S6-I4 production APIs before their red contracts are separately frozen by the author.
Any frozen core test failure after the minimal S6-I1 implementation, nondeterministic trace, fallback/base-RNG mismatch, FFE-accounting mismatch or silent NaN/Inf handling.
Any interpretation of unit-test or dry-run results as algorithm performance, objective novelty, superiority, physical validation or paper readiness.
explicitly_not_authorized: S6-I3 online CVGR state-machine production implementation
S6-I4 executable optimizer or benchmark system
S6-E0 optimizer execution, pilot, smoke run, benchmark, M, C1, F, C2, Stage B or TCAC
any formal objective or constraint evaluation or FFE
parameter tuning, performance analysis or claims
network dependency installation, remote/HPC/cloud execution or paid services
remote repository, push, public release, preregistration-platform action, preprint or submission

completion_boundary.S6_I1_green_means: The frozen deterministic mechanism-core contracts are satisfied in the recorded environment.
completion_boundary.S6_I1_green_does_not_mean: The parent optimizer, online integration, experiment system or paper evidence is complete.
completion_boundary.next_gate: Freeze the S6-I2/I3/I4 specifications and red tests, then obtain a new production-implementation authorization before writing those modules.

suggested_response: 我确认I3 Stage6分阶段实施授权候选v0.2，SHA-256为<CANDIDATE_SHA256>；I1=AUTHORIZE_DETERMINISTIC_CORE_IMPLEMENTATION；R234=AUTHORIZE_SPEC_AND_RED_TEST_PREPARATION_ONLY；T1=AUTHORIZE_FROZEN_CORE_GREEN_TESTS；T234=AUTHORIZE_RED_PHASE_ONLY；G=AUTHORIZE_LOCAL_GIT_INIT_NO_REMOTE；E=DO_NOT_AUTHORIZE_OPTIMIZER_EXECUTION；F=KEEP_FORMAL_FFE_ZERO
